newsitem.title: USA: Antitrust waiting period for CTS expires.
newsitem.headline: Antitrust waiting period for CTS expires.

text.p: CTS Corp said on Thursday that the Hart-Scott-Rodino antitrust review waiting period for its proposed acquisition of Dynamics Corp of America has terminated.

CTS has offered to pay $56.25 in cash for up to 49.9 percent of Dynamics stock. Upon completion of the tender offer, the Dynamics shares not purchased would be converted into 0.88 shares of CTS common stock, CTS said in a news release.
CTS shares on Thursday closed down 1/8 to 64. Dynamics was unchanged at 56-5/8.

A WHX Corp subsidiary has offered $56 per share in cash for Dynamics. CTS said that, given the WHX offer, CTS does not expect to receive substantial Dynamics tenders until the very end of its offer, which expires at midnight Friday.
CTS makes electronic and electromechanical components. Dynamics makes consumer electrical housewares and industrial equipment.
